Fixed. The bug was in `hashCollection` (src/CollectionImpl.js:746): the hash was finalized with `murmurHashOfSize(size, h)` where `size` came from the return value of `collection.__iterate(...)`. For OrderedMap/OrderedSet that value reflects internal list bookkeeping, which diverges from `collection.size` after element removal — so sets/maps with identical contents (and equal per `equals`) got different hashCodes depending on construction history.

The fix (matching the semantics of equal collections sharing a hash) finalizes with `murmurHashOfSize(collection.size, h)`.
